# Jakarta Apartments by UTTA

> Jakarta Apartments is an ultra-luxury apartment advisory operated by PT Berjaya Global Makmur, focused on CBD Jakarta: Sudirman, Kuningan, SCBD, and Dharmawangsa. Properties include The Elements Kuningan, Verde Two, Branz Mega Kuningan, Two Sudirman, Regent Residences Jakarta, Savyavasa, and Southgate Residence. Contact: WhatsApp +62 817-803-303, email info@jakartaapartments.co.

## Properties

- [The Elements Kuningan](https://jakartaapartmentsnew.com/the-elements): Sinar Mas Land, 2 towers (Serenity 32F/120 units with private lift, Harmony 39F/252 units), 2BR–3BR 83–186 sqm, Rp 5.0M–10.3M, siap huni, foreigner can own.

## The Elements Kuningan — Key Facts

- Developer: Sinar Mas Land (PT Bumi Serpong Damai Tbk)
- Address: Jl. Epicentrum Tengah No. 2, Karet Kuningan, Setiabudi, Jakarta Selatan 12940
- Tower Serenity: 32 floors, 120 units, 3BR only (148/186 sqm), private lift per unit, folding window balcony
- Tower Harmony: 39 floors, 252 units, 2BR to 3BR (83–141 sqm), double glass facade, balcony
- Price Serenity: Rp 7.728.000.000 – Rp 10.352.426.000
- Price Harmony: Rp 5.024.000.000 – Rp 7.525.000.000
- Semi-furnished: De Dietrich kitchen, imported marble, TOTO Premium, Mitsubishi split duct
- Foreigner ownership: Yes, Hak Pakai (PP 18/2021)
- Proximity: 2 min LRT Rasuna Said, 1 min Epiwalk Mall, 2 min MMC/Mayapada Hospital
